fields.title: 📖 Whoever is silent will be saved
fields.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr** reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

***“Whoever is silent will be saved.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Many faults begin with an unconsidered word. Whoever guards his tongue and speaks only when there is benefit has a great share of safety and security for his dīn.

immutable.source: ʿAbd ar-Razzāq aṣ-Ṣanʿānī, al-Muṣannaf, Kitāb al-Jāmiʿ, Bāb aṣ-Ṣamt, Nr. 20178
